question: In July 2025, the Ministry of Rural Development entered into an important partnership with the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) to realise the Government of India’s ‘Insurance for All by _____'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2047**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• In **July 2025**, the **Ministry of Rural Development** signed a significant partnership with the **Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)** under the Government of India’s initiative of "Insurance for All by 2047."
 
• The year **2047** holds symbolic importance as it marks the centenary of **India’s Independence**, aligning with the long-term vision of achieving universal insurance coverage.
 
• This initiative is a part of the government's broader mission to ensure **financial inclusion and social security** for every citizen, especially in rural areas.
